headline: 550 MMCFD drop in RLNG supply: Titas customers to face severe gas pressure drop
summary: A technical fault at LNG terminals in Moheshkhali has led to a significant reduction in gas supply, affecting all categories of Titas Gas customers.
details: Titas Gas authorities have announced that all categories of customers in their service areas will experience severe low gas pressure until the situation improves.
caption:
Severe gas pressure drop for all Titas Gas customers. A technical fault at Moheshkhali LNG terminals has slashed RLNG supply by 550 MMCFD.

Titas Gas authorities have announced that all categories of customers in their service areas will experience severe low gas pressure until the situation improves.

#TitasGas #GasCrisis #Bangladesh #EnergyCrisis #LNG

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo

headline: Habiganj administration lifts Section 144 as law and order returns to normal
summary: The restriction was imposed to prevent clashes between the NCP and BNP after a convoy of National Citizen Party leaders was attacked.
details: The Habiganj district administration has withdrawn the Section 144 order that was imposed across the municipality to prevent potential clashes between the NCP and BNP.
caption:
Law and order returns to normal in Habiganj as Section 144 is lifted.

The Habiganj district administration has withdrawn the Section 144 order that was imposed across the municipality to prevent potential clashes between the NCP and BNP.
